data_dir.description: Override the base data directory (default: $XDG_DATA_HOME); cannot relocate its own config directory.

poll_interval.description: Daemon poll interval as a Go duration string (default "10s").

zoxide_cap.description: Maximum zoxide rows while the query is empty (default 40).

proc_cache_ttl.description: Pane process-detection cache TTL as a duration string (default "2s").

prune_cutoff.description: Age cutoff for pruning stale rows as a duration string (default "720h").

autostart.description: Let the picker start gotomuxd when it is not running (default true).

prewarm.description: Page-cache warm on daemon start: auto (rotational disks) | on | off (default "auto").
